Use Spinner for a pending indicator and supply an accessible label that explains what is loading.

## Usage

```ts
import { spinner, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/spinner';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/spinner`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-spinner"></a>

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Spinner>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
